overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5 default reasoning_effort to "none", but the production deployment explicitly sets reasoning_effort to "low" in extra_body, which the agent's logic still bridges to /v1/responses.
why_it_breaks: The agent's fix only prevents bridging when reasoning_effort is unset (defaulting to "none"), but the production deployment explicitly sets reasoning_effort: "low" in litellm_params.extra_body. The comment at line 1127 confirms that explicit non-none reasoning_effort still triggers bridging from gpt-5.4+, so gpt-5.5 with reasoning_effort: "low" gets routed to /v1/responses, which rejects function tools with the exact error message reported.
